audience: 首次到访的年轻旅行者
style: premium editorial travel film, photorealistic, natural colour, restrained MJ-inspired soft light

clips.keyframe_prompt: A waterside arrival view with the Opera House and harbour geometry clearly separated, no tourist-poster text, foreground ferry rail giving depth, realistic spring weather
clips.motion_prompt: Locked medium-wide view from a ferry deck. The camera makes one slow 6 cm push-in toward the harbour. Water carries small natural ripples and one distant ferry moves steadily across the background; the skyline and Opera House remain perfectly rigid. The move stops for the final second.

clips.keyframe_prompt: Human-height view along a sandstone laneway with a small outdoor café, one fictional traveller seen from behind, understated wardrobe, warm side light, uncluttered foreground
clips.motion_prompt: Human-height medium-wide shot following the fictional traveller from behind for two slow steps through the sandstone lane. The camera advances smoothly by about 10 cm while a café awning stirs slightly in the breeze. Faces, masonry, tables and shopfront geometry stay stable. The traveller pauses and the frame settles for the final second.

clips.place: Mrs Macquarie's Point at blue hour
clips.keyframe_prompt: Quiet blue-hour lookout across the harbour, layered eucalyptus foreground, city lights just beginning, reflective water, contemplative closing composition without readable signs
clips.motion_prompt: Locked wide closing shot. Only the nearest eucalyptus leaves move gently in a light breeze and the harbour surface shimmers with restrained reflections. The camera performs one very gentle 8 cm pull-back, revealing a little more foreground, then holds completely still for the final second.
